summary: Iteration 62: AI-Powered Post-Mortem Analysis Testing Complete. All 25 backend tests passed (100%). Fixed critical bug in post_mortem_service.py where LLM call used wrong parameter name (content→text) and sync wrapper instead of async await. Verified: (1) POST /api/accuracy/post-mortem/{id} returns 404 for non-existent predictions, 400 for correct/unverified predictions, (2) GET /api/accuracy/post-mortem/history returns recent post-mortem results from MongoDB, (3) run_post_mortem() fetches news via Finnhub and calls GPT-4o-mini for classification, (4) run_and_update_post_mortem() updates MongoDB predictions and logs to post_mortem_log collection, (5) verify_pending_predictions() triggers AI post-mortem after heuristic classification for wrong predictions, (6) Prompt template includes all 5 failure modes, news headlines placeholder, and price action context.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: _llm_classify() was using UserMessage(content=prompt) but emergentintegrations library uses UserMessage(text=prompt)
FIXED: _llm_classify() was using asyncio.to_thread() for sync wrapper but LlmChat.send_message() is async and should be awaited directly
run_post_mortem() correctly fetches ticker news via Finnhub, falls back to market news if <3 articles
_POST_MORTEM_PROMPT includes all 5 failure modes (TECH_FAKEOUT, MACRO_SHOCK, LIQUIDITY_GAP, REGIME_SHIFT, UNKNOWN) with clear descriptions
Prompt requests JSON response with failure_code, reasoning, and key_headline fields
run_and_update_post_mortem() correctly updates MongoDB prediction doc and logs to post_mortem_log collection
verify_pending_predictions() at line ~197 calls run_and_update_post_mortem() for wrong predictions after heuristic classification
Heuristic fallback works correctly when LLM fails or EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is not set
seed_data_creation: Test predictions created and cleaned up during tests (TEST_PM62_*, TEST_CORRECT_*, TEST_UNVERIFIED_*)
